pose: A female paleontologist with braided hair is crouched over a group of deep negative relief tracks in the orange-red sandstone. These aren't raised casts; they are distinct, deep, webbed-foot impressions or holes, looking like a mold. She is using a fine brush to dust sediment from the deepest point of a sharp claw impression within one of the tracks. The lighting creates deep shadows in the impressions, highlighting the volume of the negative space. Her gaze is intense and focused on the interior structure of the mold, emphasizing the 'missing' form.
